decision: Use this source as 3D reference for a wide, open-leg sci-fi desk. Its textured views match reference-0.png: four dark rear screens, a broad flat work surface, and two separated supports. reference-2.png is a different console retained only as context. The 299,417-triangle source is too dense for one Roblox mesh; a 26,947-triangle trial kept the outline but damaged tabletop and display surfaces. The delivery candidate is a clean rebuild with recreated panels. Provisional role is decoration and width is 9.2 studs pending user approval.
